capture: Actual stdio tools/list with dummy client id, memory token store, isolated cwd; no tools/call

tools.name: account-list
tools.description: List all linked mcp-gmail accounts with their aliases and active status.

tools.name: account-me
tools.description: Show current mcp-gmail user identity. Returns email, alias (if set), and session expiry information.

tools.name: account-remove
tools.description: Remove mcp-gmail account and delete stored tokens permanently. If removing the active account, the first remaining account becomes active. Requires email or alias parameter.

accountId.description: Email address or alias of account to remove

tools.name: account-switch
tools.description: Use mcp-gmail account (smart mode). If email/alias provided and already linked, switches to it without triggering OAuth. If not linked or no email provided, triggers OAuth browser flow to add account. Returns account email, whether it was newly added, and total account count.

email.description: Email address to link (if already linked, switches without OAuth)

tools.name: categories-list
tools.description: List Gmail category labels (CATEGORY_*) with IDs and descriptions.

description.description: Description of what emails belong in this category

tools.name: label-add
tools.description: Add a label to a Gmail message

id.description: Gmail message ID to add label to

label.description: Label name or ID (use gmail-labels-list to discover available labels)

id.description: Message ID the label was added to

tools.name: label-delete
tools.description: Delete Gmail labels permanently (irreversible). System labels (INBOX, SENT, etc.) cannot be deleted.

totalRequested.description: Total number of labels requested to delete

failureCount.description: Number of labels that failed to delete

tools.name: labels-list
tools.description: List Gmail labels for label: query syntax. Case-sensitive.

name.description: Label name for use in queries (case-sensitive)

type.description: Whether this is a user-created or system label

tools.name: message-get
tools.description: Get a Gmail message by ID with flexible field selection

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. Omit for all fields. Available: id, threadId, subject, from, fromName, to, cc, bcc, date, snippet, body, isRead, isImportant, hasAttachments, attachmentCount, labelIds, folderName

contentType.description: Format for body content: text extracts plain text, html preserves HTML structure

excludeThreadHistory.description: When true, removes quoted thread history from body content

threadId.description: Thread/conversation ID for grouping related messages

receivedDateTime.description: ISO datetime when message was received

snippet.description: Short preview of the message body

isRead.description: Whether the message has been read

isImportant.description: Whether the message is marked as important/priority

hasAttachments.description: Whether the message has file attachments

labelIds.description: Gmail label IDs or Outlook category IDs

folderName.description: Name of the folder/mailbox containing this message

tools.name: message-mark-read
tools.description: Mark a Gmail message as read

id.description: Gmail message ID to mark as read
Message ID that was marked as read

ids.description: Gmail message IDs to move to trash

totalRequested.description: Total number of messages requested to trash

successCount.description: Number of messages successfully moved to trash

failureCount.description: Number of messages that failed to move

tools.name: message-respond
tools.description: Send a reply to a Gmail message

id.description: Gmail message ID to reply to

body.description: Reply body content (plain text or HTML)

id.description: Original message ID that was replied to

tools.name: message-search
tools.description: Search Gmail messages using structured query objects with flexible field selection.

query.description: Structured query object or JSON string for filtering messages. Use query-syntax prompt for reference and rawGmailQuery for Gmail syntax.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. Omit for all fields. Available: id, threadId, subject, from, fromName, to, cc, bcc, date, snippet, body, isRead, isImportant, hasAttachments, attachmentCount, labelIds, folderName

pageSize.description: Number of items per page (default: 50, max: 1000). Accepts numbers or numeric strings.

pageToken.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results (gmail format). Omit for first page.

shape.description: Response shape: objects (keyed) or arrays (columnar, matching fields order)

contentType.description: Format for body content: text extracts plain text, html preserves HTML structure

excludeThreadHistory.description: When true, removes quoted thread history from body content

$not.description: Nested condition that must NOT match

isRead.description: Filter by read status (true = read, false = unread)

tools.name: message-send
tools.description: Send an email message through Gmail

to.description: Recipient email address(es). For multiple recipients, use comma-separated: "alice@example.com, bob@example.com"

bcc.description: BCC recipients (hidden copy). For multiple recipients, use comma-separated: "alice@example.com, bob@example.com" (optional)

body.description: Email body content (plain text or HTML)

id.description: Unique ID of the sent message

sentAt.description: When the message was sent (ISO datetime)

recipientCount.description: Total number of recipients (to + cc + bcc)

webLink.description: Link to view the sent message in Gmail
